tools.name: compress_image
tools.description: Re-encode a single raster image to webp, jpeg, png or avif, optionally resizing it and/or converting it to grayscale. HEIC/HEIF input is converted to JPEG first, and SVG input is rasterised at 300 DPI, fitted inside 800x800 unless width or height is given. Lossy for webp, jpeg and avif at any qualit

tools.name: generate_qr_code
tools.description: Render text or a URL as a QR code image. Returns JSON { dataUrl, text, size } where dataUrl is a base64 PNG data URI embedded in the response — not a hosted link, so nothing is stored and the image cannot be fetched later. Runs locally and costs nothing. Writing only — it cannot read or decode an ex

tools.name: generate_image
tools.description: Generate a new image from a text description with a diffusion model. Returns a single PNG; over MCP it arrives inline when under 1MB and otherwise as a stored URL that stays retrievable for about 24 hours. This invents an image from scratch — it cannot edit, upscale or restyle a picture you already

tools.name: split_image
tools.description: Cut one storyboard, collage or grid image into its separate panels and return them as a ZIP, one file per panel in reading order. Over MCP the ZIP is not inlined: it comes back as a stored URL that stays retrievable for about 24 hours. Two modes. Give both rows and cols for an exact equal division,

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "media" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: generate_qr_code · Private data: compress_image, generate_image, split_image · Public sink: compress_image, split_image · Destructive: compress_image, split_image.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: generate_qr_code · Private data: compress_image, generate_image, split_image · Public sink: compress_image, split_image · Destructive: compress_image, split_image

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
